content: Elderly UX pitfalls: information overload, complex/nested navigation, no feedback on actions, trendy dynamic/animated UI elements, jargon, ignoring cognitive load (should chunk tasks with progress/save points), poor screen-reader/zoom support, low contrast color choices, small body text (should be 16px+ with generous line-height and support dynamic text scaling), lack of error tolerance (no confirm/undo on destructive actions), and failure to build trust/emotional safety in the interface.
